findings.title: Inconsistent string formatting style
findings.body: The function now uses `str.format_map` while the neighbouring code in the same file (line 4) uses an f-string. According to custom instructions in 'Naming Consistency' (A function longer than 50 lines or nested more than 3 levels deep is split; name the piece that can be extracted): the new code introduces a second formatting style next to an existing one, violating the repository's consistency rule.

summary.problem: The change introduces an inconsistent string formatting style in a function that previously used f-strings.
summary.done_well: The refactor improves maintainability by using a dictionary-based format method, but it breaks local consistency.
